John Seek Septic Tank Pumping has been a family owned and operated business since 1950. We are certified system inspectors available to meet your needs seven days a week. We specialize in septic tank cleaning, maintenance, grease trap cleaning, repairs, and new drain field installation — serving Montgomery County and surrounding areas for over 75 years.
